session_notes: Heavy scaffolding throughout. Mosaic, network graph, and data table used (B1 breadth). Wrong target = 'Tag (Training/Test)'. Depth-3 tree built. Most moves prompted or demonstrated by teacher — many behaviors reduced to Acquire due to Section 6 scaffold rule.

B1.note: Used mosaic plot, network graph, bar chart, and data table — broadest representation variety in cohort. B1-A2 by variety but lack of independent connection-making.

B3.note: Dragged 'Tag (Training/Test)' as target. This column has two values but represents data split role, not class label. B3-A1 confirmed; B3-D2 absent.

B8.note: All metric reading was teacher-prompted or teacher-labeled. No point where Calvin independently read and named a metric value. not_measurable.
